hero_kpi_rationale: The operating margin (32.5%) reflects the group's ability to convert revenues into operating profit. It would increase by +1.8 points year-over-year, demonstrating structural improvement in cost discipline and digitalization, critical for a universal bank.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenues.
kpis.description: The operating margin improves due to cost discipline and increased digitalization.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Net interest income divided by average earning assets, reflecting the profitability of core banking activities.
kpis.description: The net interest margin remains solid, supported by active management of loan and deposit portfolios.
kpis.signal: Stability in banking asset profitability despite a volatile rate environment.

kpis.name: Total Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group at the end of the period.
kpis.description: The group maintains headcount stabilization with a focus on productivity and process automation.
kpis.signal: Slight reduction in headcount despite digital transformation.

kpis.name: Cost-to-Income Ratio
kpis.explanation: Operating costs divided by total revenues, a key indicator of operational efficiency.
kpis.description: The cost-to-income ratio improves due to digitalization initiatives and workforce optimization, positioning Santander among the most efficient in the sector.

kpis.name: Digital Service Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Growth in recurring revenues from digital services and banking subscriptions.
kpis.description: Digital services (subscriptions, payments, APIs) are becoming a profitability pillar, generating recurring and sustainable revenues.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in high-margin digital services.

kpis.name: AI Adoption in Customer Service
kpis.explanation: Share of customer interactions handled via chatbots and conversational AI assistants.
kpis.description: Adoption of AI chatbots accelerates across the 10 countries where Santander has deployed the solution, improving productivity and customer satisfaction.
kpis.signal: Massive acceleration in conversational AI adoption in customer service.

ai_positioning.summary: Santander adopts AI as a lever for operational efficiency and customer experience, without making it a central business model. It integrates AI into critical processes (conversational chatbots, credit scoring, fraud detection, cybersecurity) through strategic partnerships and regional innovation centers.
evidence: Deployment of conversational AI in 10 countries
Partnership with Microsoft for generative AI
AI innovation centers in Madrid and São Paulo
